from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u021/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if row[0] == background:
            continue
        first_bg = next((i for i, v in enumerate(row) if v == background), len(row))
        if 0 < first_bg < len(row) and all(v == background for v in row[first_bg:]) and all(v == row[0] for v in row[:first_bg]):
            out[r][first_bg:] = [1] * (len(row) - first_bg)
    return out
'''
file=programs/'task-f597e3cc.py'
file.write_text(code)

expected=[row[:] for row in demo]; expected[8][4:]=[1]*4
print(ns['transform'](demo)==expected)
test=[[6]*8 for _ in range(15)]; test[1]=[9]*4+[6]*4; test[10]=[9]*8
